fouls.name: Direction Fault (Changing Direction)
fouls.description: An active chaser turns around or reverses direction towards the opposite post before reaching the Free Zone.
fouls.penalty: Foul signal; any touch made during or after the foul is void, runner cannot be dismissed.

fouls.name: Central Lane Crossing Violation
fouls.description: An active chaser's body crosses or steps completely over the central lane to the other half without going around the post.
fouls.penalty: Foul called; chaser must immediately return to the correct side without tagging defenders.

fouls.name: False / Silent Kho
fouls.description: Touching a sitting teammate without clearly and audibly saying 'Kho', or giving Kho while the recipient is not fully seated.
fouls.penalty: Foul, chaser must re-give Kho or forfeit advantage.

fouls.name: Shoulder Line Fault (Receding)
fouls.description: An active chaser turns their shoulders more than 90 degrees away from the taken direction while chasing.
fouls.penalty: Foul; play is reset by the referee.
